intro: Hungary's economy relies heavily on car-making, exports to Germany and a growing number of Asian battery and car factories.

chapters.title: Cars and batteries
text: Audi, Mercedes-Benz and BMW build cars in Hungary, and Chinese companies are building electric car and battery factories. The pharmaceutical company Gedeon Richter is one of the largest in Central Europe.

chapters.title: Paprika, wine and spas
text: Hungary is famous for paprika and Tokaji, a sweet wine once called 'the wine of kings'. Budapest's thermal baths draw millions of tourists. Hungary uses its own currency, the forint.

keyTerms.meaning: A red spice made from dried peppers.
